newsitem.title: UK: ML Labs gains after newspaper recommendation.
newsitem.headline: ML Labs gains after newspaper recommendation.

text.p: Shares in M.L. Laboratories Plc rose in early trading on Monday after a recommendation in the Sunday Times, dealers said.
Shares in the drug development company were up 12p at 189-1/2 by 0732 GMT in volume of 130,687 shares.
The paper noted that the stock had more than halved since reaching a peak more than a year ago, yet is one of the few emerging UK drug companies to bring a product to market.

Rating the stock a "buy," the paper said ML will later this year be reporting results of tests on a potential cancer vaccine "which some brokers suspect could mark the start of a rally in the shares."
